ModMetaData.name: Celestial Lighting
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description:
Latitude- and season-aware sky lighting.
- Shadows now lean with the sun's real seasonal position instead of always pointing the same way: the effect grows stronger the further a colony sits from the equator, and mirrors between the northern and southern hemispheres. - Sunrise and sunset last longer and glow warmer at high latitudes, matching the long, colorful twilight seen at real-world high latitudes. Colonies near the equator see little change. - Shadows also stretch very slightly longer on the side of the map the sun is leaning away from, subtly following the same seasonal lean.
